thread:
ana: Heads-up — a customer is hitting schema validation errors when a function-call's args stream gets cut mid-object. They see 'Unexpected end of JSON input' from the validation layer.

support-bot: Ticket created: #8765. Pinging eng-runtime and ingress teams. :rotating_light:

matt: Can you share a raw capture of the SSE stream? Suspect chunks are splitting the JSON object on our side.

ana: Paste of the captured data events (excerpt):
```text
data: {'name':'lookup_customer','args':{'id':'cus_12345','filters':[{'type':'email','value':'jess@'
```

sarah: Looks like the 'data' lines are being emitted mid-string — email value is split across two data events. That would break our JSON parser if we're validating per-event.

eli: Repro locally with a proxy that uses chunked transfer. If upstream emits a long JSON and the proxy slices it, our per-event validation throws. Repro snippet (node):
```js
const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { Accept: 'text/event-stream' } });
for await (const chunk of res.body) { console.log(chunk.toString()); }
```
You can see chunks splitting inside strings.

matt: Proposed options:
- Reassemble consecutive 'data:' frames into one buffer before parsing/validation.
- Make validation tolerant to mid-stream joins for SSE (wait for matching braces).
- Short-term: ask infra to buffer/terminate streaming at gateway for small messages.

ana: Customer needs a temporary mitigation. @infra-bot can we add a gateway reassembly middleware to join SSE 'data' lines until a complete JSON object is observed?

infra-bot: Created INF-321 to add SSE reassembly middleware in front of the validation layer. Will try a hotfix today, ETA EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sarah: I'll add unit tests that simulate data events split at random positions and ensure runtime does not validate until object complete.

eli: Also adding defensive logging to record fragment sizes and boundary offsets so we can trace which proxies are splitting.

matt: Assigning to eng-runtime. Please update ticket #8765 with repro steps and the hotfix plan. :thumbsup:

ana: Thanks — keeping customer updated. Will post follow-up when INF-321 is live.
